name: Classic tenant-isolation IDOR on resource lookup

input.title: Authenticated user can read other tenants' invoices by id
input.summary: GET /api/invoices/:id does not check that the requesting user's tenant owns the invoice before returning it. Tenant A user can read Tenant B invoices.

rationale: Real horizontal privilege escalation. Boundary sentence is fillable: actor who could previously only read Tenant A invoices can now read Tenant B invoices, which the multi-tenant security model did not permit.
